# Notes App Workspace Instructions

- [x] Verify that the `copilot-instructions.md` file in the `.github` directory is created.
- [x] Clarify project requirements. The project is a Java 17 Maven desktop notes app.
- [x] Scaffold the project. The app uses a layered structure with model, repository, service, and Swing UI packages.
- [x] Customize the project. JSON-backed persistence, note editing, and a desktop GUI with theming are implemented.
- [x] Install required extensions. None required for this project.
- [x] Compile the project. Source-level compilation is clean.
- [x] Create and run task. Not needed for this project.
- [x] Launch the project. The app starts from `com.example.notesapp.NotesApp`.
- [x] Ensure documentation is complete. README and workspace instructions match the current implementation.

- Use plain Java and keep the code object oriented.
- Keep persistence file-backed and local by default.
- Prefer small, focused classes with clear responsibilities.
